CODEX-3 BLOCKER CLEARED. The assisted-order wizard lane is committed, pushed and handed off.

SHA 33af738e5825e0032e249dbf16ef1d7055d6c848 on fable/assisted-order-customer-flow-20260819 (pushed to origin).
Base 5bb3fa9. Verified: zero commits between 5bb3fa9 and 8dabe222 touch client/src/research/assisted-order/** or shared/research/assisted-order/**, so this merges clean onto the current head.
Focused suite at that SHA: 5 files, 37 tests, all passing (npx vitest run client/src/research/assisted-order shared/research/assisted-order).

CLAUDE_CODEX_FLEET_OWNERSHIP_2026-08-20.md line 43-46 says Codex 3 must be QA because C:/xenios-wt/assisted-order-flow holds 717 uncommitted lines. That is now stale: the work is a proven pushed SHA, not a dirty worktree. Codex 3 can validate against 33af738e instead of being blocked by it. Its qty-100 conformance tests still belong to it and still must agree with your lead-retained authority change.

TWO DEFECTS REPAIRED that made the flow unusable in a real browser:
1. The client never sent the assisted_order_form_v1 acknowledgments that service.requireAgreements verifies by copy hash, so every real submission was refused 400 agreements. The server E2E only passed because it spreads a server-side FORM_PAIRS constant. Config parser now carries requiredAgreements AND formAcknowledgments; the RUO fact renders only when an RUO line is in the basket.
2. Success navigated .../confirmation?reference=XRR- but the registered route is .../confirmation/:publicReference, so confirmation fell through to the status page and 404ed. Now navigates the registered path form via wouter.

ONE LEAD-OWNED SEAM I DID NOT TAKE (outside my lease, recommend you apply):
clearAssistedOrderStorage (client/src/research/assisted-order/storage.ts) is dead code, zero call sites repo-wide. EarlyAccessRoute.tsx signOut already calls clearBrowserCart / clearCartRecovery / clearPendingAttempt; it should call this too, or a shared machine leaves the previous customer status token and draft for whoever unlocks next. One import plus one call.

CONFIRMS YOUR LEAD-RETAINED QTY-100 NOTE: production-catalog.ts pins minimumQuantity 1 / increment 1 / maximum null, and ASSISTED_ORDER_MAX_QUANTITY is 100_000. The client already honors whatever maximum the server projects, so your authority change lands without further client work.

DID NOT ADD a manual affiliate-code field: service.ts ignores input.affiliateAttributionRef and derives attribution from the verified cookie only. A client field would be silently discarded. Needs your server decision first.

My lease is in handoff state. Not taking another lane without your assignment.
